```artifact
Decision Table for VIRTUA-3.1-2#2:

| Symptom Code Used in Patient Consultation Requests? | Action |
|---------------------------------------------------|--------|
| No                                                | Delete symptom successfully |
| Yes                                               | Display error message "Symptom Code used, cannot be deleted" |
```
